title: Two agents have different jobs.
sub: The factory creates the product. The traveler uses the product.
body:
You describe a product

Factory voice assistant → build worker → independent checks → released preview

You ask about a trip

Travel voice assistant → source tools → validated data → visual cards

The attached scaffold and builder currently run separately. Their automatic release bridge is extension work.
notes: This distinction is essential. The existing travel specialist choosing source tools is not the coding builder. Identify the missing bridge explicitly. Ask the room: which agent needs permission to change files?

sub: The cards and factory controller are application code.
body:
PartIts job
Rasa MantleRun the conversation, skills and tool constraints
DeepgramTurn speech into text and text into speech
OpenAI Agents APIRun a builder session that survives restarts, inside a managed harness (the service runs the agent’s loop for you)

notes: Spend two minutes here. Mantle is the orchestrator in Rasa; the Agents API is a managed service, not another local library. Deepgram is the speech provider. Neither provider automatically supplies this dashboard.

title: A brief becomes a testable request.
sub: “Make it better” leaves the builder guessing.
body:
“Show only two currencies, with the reference date. If rates fail, say they are unavailable.”
  • Four input rates produce two rows.
  • The publication date is visible.
  • Daily rates never say “live”.
  • Source failure produces no invented rate.
notes: Give the group a concrete feature from the existing code. Public requirements and public tests are useful to the builder. Protect the evaluator from writes; hiding every test is not the defining idea.

title: The builder cannot grade its own homework.
sub: An independent verifier checks the proposed artifact.
body:
Task + product files

Allowed changes only
Development tests available

attempt

Protected acceptance

Independent result
Task and artifact fingerprints (short codes made from the files)

The builder may see example tests. It never sees or edits the acceptance tests that decide.
notes: A copied directory is not an operating-system sandbox, so protect execution as well as files. Explain both logical separation and actual execution isolation. Hashes detect mismatches but are not permissions. The existing Python code gate uses macOS sandbox-exec; the fallback checks JSON as data.

title: A completed session still needs a decision.
sub: A setup failure is different from a bad product.
body:
01

ACCEPT

The attempt passed the specified checks. Release checks still follow.

02

REJECT

A product requirement failed. Change the proposal and try again.

03

NOT_READY (could not run)

A dependency, account or verifier failed. No product verdict exists.
notes: Ask for examples of each result. A timed-out API request cannot be labeled REJECT solely because the provider failed. Passing a suite is bounded evidence, not proof of all future behavior.

sub: People define the standards and own exceptions.

notes: Define dark factory as reducing routine manual intervention within a bounded workflow. Tests are not the only possible control; policies, human escalation, monitoring and rollback matter. The workshop is an introduction, not proof of unattended production readiness.

assistant confidently wrong?”

Trade an example. Explain how you would detect it. Swap roles when you return.
notes: Networking break. Encourage a concrete failure rather than a general product pitch. Example: daylight-saving transition, stale flight observation, ambiguous meeting date, or source outage.

title: Voice has its own acceptance tests.
sub: Passing text tests leaves important behavior untested.
body:
01

A short reply

Does “yes” become the right confirmed action?

02

An interruption

Does playback stop while the user changes the request?

03

A failed source

Does speech explain the problem while the board keeps useful data?
notes: Optional. Check ASR, TTS, timing, interruption and state retention. The version update uses deepgram_flux for Flux ASR and deepgram for Aura-2 TTS. If voice falls back to text, mark voice incomplete.
